name: Mealie
description: Recipe manager and meal planner that imports recipes from a URL and builds shopping lists.

ru.description: Менеджер рецептов и планировщик меню: импортирует рецепты по ссылке и составляет списки покупок.

meta.about: Material design inspired recipe manager with category and tag management, shopping-lists, meal-planner, and site customizations. Mealie is focused on simple user interactions to keep the whole family using the app.
